observed_evidence.source: 2026-10-29 read-only production Supabase examination and existing P0 issue #4446

terminal_rule: Do not claim live prior to protected exact-head CI, safe migration and GitHub main-to-Netlify-to-real consented browser-to-Supabase ID readback, experiment sample proof and verified commercial outcomes.
